en: Black-and-white postcard view of a broad, mostly empty square bordered by late‑19th‑century multi‑storey buildings. In the center background stands a large, symmetrical three‑storey institutional building with a modestly decorated central entrance and mansard‑style roof, likely a school or municipal facility. Flanking it on both sides are attached townhouses or apartment blocks with shops at street level. A tall, slender pole (possibly for lighting or a flag) rises from the middle of the square. The edges of the image are framed by a white postcard border.
